import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
raw="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1

G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=[l.split() for l in raw.split("\n")];al=ls[0];BL={}
for r_ in ls[1:]:
    for b,v in zip(al,r_[1:]): BL[(r_[0],b)]=int(v)
def nw(s1,s2,go=11,ge=1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-10**9
    M=[[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];Ix=[r[:] for r in M];Iy=[r[:] for r in M]
    pM=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];pIx=[r[:] for r in pM];pIy=[r[:] for r in pM]
    M[0][0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i][0]=-go-ge*(i-1);pIx[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0][j]=-go-ge*(j-1);pIy[0][j]=2
    Sr=[[BL.get((a,b),-2) for b in s2] for a in s1]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mp,Ixp,Iyp=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1];Mi,Ixi,Iyi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i];Si=Sr[i-1]
        pMi,pIxi,pIyi=pM[i],pIx[i],pIy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=Mp[j-1],Ixp[j-1],Iyp[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mp[j]-go,Ixp[j]-ge,Iyp[j]-go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Ixi[j]=a;pIxi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Ixi[j]=b;pIxi[j]=1
            else: Ixi[j]=c;pIxi[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mi[j-1]-go,Ixi[j-1]-go,Iyi[j-1]-ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Iyi[j]=a;pIyi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Iyi[j]=b;pIyi[j]=1
            else: Iyi[j]=c;pIyi[j]=2
    st=int(np.argmax([M[n][m],Ix[n][m],Iy[n][m]]));i,j=n,m;A=[];C=[];P=[pM,pIx,pIy]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append("-");C.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append("-");i-=1;continue
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[0][i][j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append("-");ns=P[1][i][j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append("-");C.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[2][i][j];j-=1;st=ns
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(C))
def up(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

REF=up("P42884")
members=[("Aad14 P42884 (376 aa)",up("P42884")),("Aad4 Q07747 (329 aa)",up("Q07747")),
         ("Aad6 P43547 (212 aa)",up("P43547")),("Aad10 P47182 (288 aa)",up("P47182")),
         ("Aad16 Q02895/YPL088W (342 aa)",up("Q02895")),("Aad3 P25612 (363 aa)",up("P25612")),
         ("Aad15 Q08361 (143 aa)",up("Q08361")),
         ("P. chrysosporium AAD Q01752\n(GO ISS with-from, 385 aa)",up("Q01752"))]
cols=[71,76,103,151]; labels=["Asp71","Tyr76","Lys103","His151"]
rows=[];ids=[]
for nm,s in members:
    a,b=nw(REF,s); c=0; got={}
    ov=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!="-" and y!="-"]
    ids.append(100*sum(x==y for x,y in ov)/len(ov))
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!="-":
            c+=1
            if c in cols: got[c]=y
    rows.append([got.get(k,"-") for k in cols])
    print(f"{nm.splitlines()[0]:32s} {rows[-1]}  %id_to_Aad14={ids[-1]:.1f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8,4.8))
names=[m[0] for m in members]
intact=np.array([[1 if r[i]==rows[0][i] else 0 for i in range(4)] for r in rows])
ax.imshow(intact,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(rows)):
    for j in range(4):
        ax.text(j,i,rows[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=13,
                fontweight="bold" if rows[i][j]!=rows[0][j] else "normal")
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Aldo-keto reductase catalytic tetrad, Aad14 coordinates\ngreen: same residue as Aad14; red: substituted or region absent",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
